conventions.missing: Absent/non-finite values are missing, never zero.
conventions.score: Higher is better; MSE lower is better. Pair by (relation, query), not row order.
conventions.confidence: Vectors retain original component indices; gain channel is index 3. direct_gain_alpha is a distinct recorded calibration, not substituted confidence.
conventions.continuation: Recorded future values/offsets/TV only; an isolated continuation ranking counterfactual is missing (not supplied by this runner).
conventions.read_credit: Aggregate actual read credit, not attribution to the original writing actor.

read_use.meaning: Observed target/support identity reuse across (relation identity, generation); versions do not create a new relation. Not a causal benefit or an origin-relation claim.
